title: Credit Controller
description:
Role Purpose
- To support the timely collection of outstanding customer debts, minimise overdue balances and support the cash flow of the business. The role involves proactively managing customer accounts, resolving payment queries and maintaining accurate records, whilst building positive customer relationships and ensuring compliance with company credit control procedures.

Key Responsibilities
- Debt Collection: Proactively chase overdue balances by telephone and email, maintain accurate records of customer interactions and credit control activity on k 8, and ensure monthly statements and credit chase streams are processed promptly.
- Customer Accounts: Manage a portfolio of accounts, including key customers, encouraging timely payments in line with agree credit terms.
- Credit Management: Monitor overdue accounts, apply and release credit stops in accordance with company procedures, and review customer credit limits.
- Query Resolution: Work closely with customers, branches and sales teams to resolve invoice disputes and outstanding queries promptly.
- Debt Recovery: Identify potentially problematic debts, issue formal payment notices and escalate accounts for legal recovery where necessary.
- Account Administration: Process new credit applications, set up accounts on k 8 and CRM, and maintain accurate customer records.
- Payment Processing: Process customer card payments, authorised settlement discounts, credit adjustments and write-offs.
- Account Adjustments: Process authorised customer settlement discounts, credit notes and bad debt write-offs.
- Reporting and Housekeeping: Maintain accurate collection notes, monitor outstanding invoices and review dormant customer accounts.
- Group Support: Provide holiday cover and support consistent credit control procedures across the Group.

Skills and Experience
- Previous credit control or accounts receivable experience.
- Confident communicator with strong negotiation and customer service skills.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage competing priorities.
- Good attention to detail and ability to resolve problems efficiently.
- Competent in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and accounting systems.
- Experience of Kerridge k 8 and the construction or distribution sector would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes
- A proactive, organised and commercially aware individual with a firm but professional approach to debt collection. Able to work independently, build positive customer relationships and contribute effectively to the wider finance team.

title: Minute taking Business Administrator
description:
Connect 2 Luton are excited to recruit a Minute Taking Administrator i on behalf of Luton Borough Council.

Main purpose of position:

The post holder will provide high level administration support and information to the Strategy, Engagement & Implementation. They will support the management of the Team inbox's to action the tasks according to priority with the aim of improving the quality of data that is recorded on social care systems. They will also provide support to ensure the efficient running of projects. They will support the administration tasks in relation to external suppliers and contribute to the performance management in relation to the key performance indicators set.

As a Business support officer you will be responsible to:
- Undertake and lead on complex administrative tasks in a high volume and deadline driven environment
- Manage specific project support tasks with minimal supervision as part of own workload as required by line management
- Support the management of team email box(s) to ensure action in a timely way ensuring accurate recording
- Ensure data recorded is accurate and concise
- Creation, development and maintenance of records, files and statistical information for evidence based data
- Handle conflicting priorities from managers being aware of public scrutiny and partnership working within LBC and with local stakeholders requiring a high level of professionalism
- Taking on a coordination function between the council and externally commissioned resource to support timely actions and forward planning
- Manage the logistics and administration of all identified project meetings, to include suitable minute taking records, ensuring the division maintain a uniformed communication strategy and information flow across all meetings
- Maintain and collate management information to meet divisional management requirements, and produce periodic reports within defined time-scales to enable management to review performance
- Develop, implement, maintain and monitor administrative systems and procedures to support operational needs of the division, ensure the team is up to date with public information, national and local policies, procedures and strategy
- Be able, and as a nominated responsible officer, to undertake the processing of invoices, and stores requisitions, managing the distribution and the returning of laptops and equipment as and when required , maintaining accurate records
- To participate and where required facilitate working relationships with teams and staff from other divisions to ensure consistency as far as practicable
- Contribute to the maintenance of a healthy, safe, effective working environment, monitoring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements including H&S, property, equipment issues, and IT facilities
- Ensure that relevant corporate and departmental procedures are available and kept up to date

Skills and Experience
- Demonstrable administrative experience including developing, managing and maintaining complex administrative systems and procedures
- Some experience of organising and leading project work
- Previous local authority experience or Social Care setting
- Ability to communicate and build effective relationships with staff and stakeholders in a polite manner at levels
- Ability to write clear letters and reports
- Good IT skills
- Able to use own initiative
- Ability to perform basic calculations and analyse and interpret data
- Excellent administrative and organisational skills
- Able to provide a quality service to customers
- Some understanding of national policy surrounding health and social care
- Education to Level 2 Business management or equivalent experience
- Able to attend meetings and undertake work at various locations throughout the Borough

About Us

Luton Borough Council have partnered with Kent County Council to create Connect 2 Luton, a recruitment managed service for all contingent temporary agency, contract, and interim roles at the Council.

Our heritage and being local government owned which means we have a wealth of knowledge and expertise within the public sector, with many of our employees having previously worked for the Council or have supplied previously into the Council, for several years.

We are an equal opportunities employment agency and business that positively encourages applications from all suitably qualified and eligible candidates.

title: Receptionist
description: We are seeking a dedicated and capable GP Receptionist to join our practice and contribute to the delivery of high quality patient care. Working Hours The working hours will follow a set weekly pattern: Tuesday 8am - 4pm Wednesday to Friday 8am - 6.30pm This role is central to the efficient operation of the surgery, requiring excellent communication skills, strong organisation, and a commitment to providing a courteous and supportive service to all patients. As the first point of contact, you will play a key role in ensuring that every individual receives prompt assistance and a positive experience. Responsibilities include providing a courteous and professional reception service for patients and visitors, managing enquiries both in person and over the telephone, and supporting patients in accessing the appropriate services. The role involves accurately booking, amending, and managing appointments, maintaining up-to-date records, and handling documentation with diligence. The GP Receptionist also processes prescription requests in line with practice procedures, supports clinicians with administrative tasks, and ensures that patient confidentiality is upheld at all times. In addition, the position contributes to general administrative duties such as filing, scanning, and managing correspondence, while maintaining an organised and welcoming reception area. A commitment to teamwork, professionalism, and high quality service is essential to supporting the practice and delivering excellent patient care. Key Responsibilities Patient Reception & Enquiries - Greet patients in a friendly and professional manner. - Manage patient enquiries in person, via telephone, and online. - Provide information regarding appointments, services, and procedures. - Maintain confidentiality in line with GDPR. Appointment & Administrative Support - Book, amend, and cancel appointments using the clinical system. - Process repeat prescriptions. - Update records. - Assist with referrals, results, recalls, and clinical admin. - Ensure accurate data entry. Reception & Office Duties - Answer incoming calls promptly and signpost appropriately. - Handle post, emails, and internal communication. - Maintain a tidy reception area. - Process payments where required. Teamwork & Practice Support - Work effectively with clinical and admin staff. - Follow practice policies and safeguarding guidelines. - Participate in meetings and training. - Provide cover for colleagues as needed.

title: Receptionist
description: Shefford Health Centre are on the look out for a dynamic receptionist. this person must have excellent people skills. The purpose of the role is to: Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice, including the provision of secretarial and clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team as necessary by the needs of the business. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the practice reception team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the line management/Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointments system Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations, and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team member and associated healthcare agencies and providers Providing clerical assistance, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required; loading and emptying the dishwasher and keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy
